# Retirement and Recovery Management Prompt

Apply after [base.md](base.md).

Find owners, consumers, references, automations, replacements, data, dependencies, and rollback needs. Prefer disable or quarantine, migrate consumers, verify replacement, then archive. Permanent deletion is a separate explicit decision.

Use recoverable exact-target operations and preserve a manifest. Never use broad recursive deletion or infer that an apparently unused skill has no consumers.

Verify absence from discovery, continued consumer behavior, retained recovery, and audit state before marking `RETIRED`.
